full_judgment: 2. The petitioner instituted Title Suit No. 83 of 2000 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sundargonj, Gaibandha, for partition. The case of the plaintiff in short is that Perm Chand Roy, Ram Chandra Roy and Charu Chandra Roy were C.S. recorded owners in possession of the suit property. They gave pattan of the said property to Sakhawat All and Babor Ali, who cultivated the same. The S.A. record has been prepared in the names of Sakhawat and Babor Ali. On 18th March, 1963 Shakawat Ali sold 50 decimals of land to the plaintiff's father Obaidul by a registered deed and delivered him possession. The Khatian has also been prepared in the name of Obaidul, who during his ownership in possession therein on 11th April, 2000 sold 50 decimals of land to the plaintiff-petitioner by 2(two) registered deeds and delivered him possession and since then he has been owning and possessing the same. Aforesaid Babor Ali died leaving behind his two sons, the defendant No. 2 Taslim and the defendant No. 3 Matiar as his heirs. The plaintiff claimed amicable partition for his 50 decimals of land to the defendants, who on the first part of Baishakh, 1407 B. S. denied to the same and hence the suit had been filed.
